rules.name: recon-legacy-history-03-view-definitions
rules.sql: SELECT table_name AS view_name, CHAR_LENGTH(view_definition) AS definition_chars, LOCATE('valuation_date_table', view_definition) AS pos_valuation_date_table, LOCATE('previous_helper', view_definition) AS pos_previous_helper, LOCATE('cache_table', view_definition) AS pos_cache_table, view_definition FROM information_schema.views WHERE table_schema = 'dbsystemuat' AND table_name IN ('recon_view_data_cfs', 'helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cfs', 'helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view_cfs') ORDER BY table_name

SELECT table_name AS view_name, LOCATE('previous_helper', view_definition) > 0 AS reads_previous, LOCATE('helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table', view_definition) > 0 AS reads_settle_cache, LOCATE('valuation_date_table', view_definition) > 0 AS reads_valuation_date FROM information_schema.views WHERE table_schema = 'dbsystemuat' AND (LOCATE('previous_helper', view_definition) > 0 OR LOCATE('helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table', view_definition) > 0) ORDER BY table_name

SELECT routine_name, routine_type, last_altered FROM information_schema.routines WHERE routine_schema = 'dbsystemuat' AND (LOCATE('previous_helper', routine_definition) > 0 OR LOCATE('recon_refresh', routine_definition) > 0) ORDER BY routine_name

expect.reason: the CFS recon views must exist
